sentences.text: Farrokh `` Freddie '' Mercury -LRB- née Bulsara ; 5 September 1946 -- 24 November 1991 -RRB- was a British singer , songwriter and record producer , known as the lead vocalist and co-principal songwriter of the rock band Queen .	Queen	Queen (band)	lead vocalist	lead vocalist
He also became known for his flamboyant stage persona and four-octave vocal range .	octave	octave

Mercury wrote and composed numerous hits for Queen -LRB- including `` Bohemian Rhapsody '' , `` Killer Queen '' , `` Somebody to Love '' , `` Do n't Stop Me Now '' , `` Crazy Little Thing Called Love '' , and `` We Are the Champions '' -RRB- ; occasionally served as a producer and guest musician -LRB- piano or vocals -RRB- for other artists ; and concurrently led a solo career while performing with Queen .	Queen	Queen (band)	Bohemian Rhapsody	Bohemian Rhapsody	Killer Queen	Killer Queen	Somebody to Love	Somebody to Love (Queen song)	Crazy Little Thing Called Love	Crazy Little Thing Called Love	We Are the Champions	We Are the Champions

Mercury was born of Parsi descent in the Sultanate of Zanzibar and grew up there and in India until his mid-teens , before moving with his family to Middlesex , England -- ultimately forming the band Queen in 1970 with Brian May and Roger Taylor .	Queen	Queen (band)	Sultanate of Zanzibar	Sultanate of Zanzibar	Parsi	Parsi	Brian May	Brian May	Roger Taylor	Roger Taylor (Queen drummer)
Mercury died in 1991 at age 45 due to complications from AIDS , having confirmed the day before his death that he had contracted the disease .	AIDS	HIV/AIDS#Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome

In 1992 , Mercury was posthumously awarded the Brit Award for Outstanding Contribution to British Music , and had a tribute concert held at Wembley Stadium , London .	London	London	Brit Award	Brit Awards	tribute concert	The Freddie Mercury Tribute Concert

As a member of Queen , he was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2001 , the Songwriters Hall of Fame in 2003 , the UK Music Hall of Fame in 2004 , and the band received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2002 .	Queen	Queen (band)	Rock	Rock music	Hollywood	Hollywood Records	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	UK Music Hall of Fame	UK Music Hall of Fame	Hollywood Walk of Fame	Hollywood Walk of Fame
In 2002 , he was placed at number 58 in the BBC 's poll of the 100 Greatest Britons .	100 Greatest Britons	100 Greatest Britons

Consistently voted one of the greatest singers in the history of popular music , Mercury was voted best male singer of all time in a 2005 poll organised by Blender and MTV2 ; was elected in 2009 as the best rock singer of all time by Classic Rock readers ; was ranked at 18 on the 2008 Rolling Stone list of the 100 greatest singers ever ; -- and was described by Greg Prato of AllMusic as `` one of rock 's greatest all-time entertainers , '' with `` one of the greatest voices in all of music .
